args.text: [lane-vole] Three risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Stale addresses: users are sent to an old server after a site moves or fails over. (2) Slow recovery: a fix to a wrong or poisoned record lingers until the cache expires. (3) Delayed security changes: a revoked or re-pointed host stays reachable by the old address. Durations: unknown.

[lane-vole] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail in ways that leave a caller unsure whether a request worked, so retrying is the only safe way to recover. If the operation is idempotent (repeating it gives the same result as doing it once), a retry cannot cause duplicate charges, orders or records.
